messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — FinApp (FIN-789) is asking for a rate-limit bump and APAC allowlist for onboarding next week. Expecting a QPS spike (20 -> ~200). Can we provision temporarily? cc @alex_se

alex_se: Thanks — rough ask: raise burst/steady limits, add ap-southeast-1 to region allowlist. Do we have dates for the spike and renewal posture?

tia_success: Onboarding kickoff Wed 10am PT. Training + scripted load test during week. Renewal in 6 months, account health currently neutral — would like to avoid any perf issues.

alex_se: Ok. I'll draft config and get ops to queue it. Quick question: do they need a permanent change or just for the onboarding window?

maria_cs: Temporary for 7 days post-kickoff, then revert to previous limits unless they expand. Also capture feedback during training (perf + billing visibility).

raj_support: Can you drop the exact config we should apply? I'll raise a support change ticket and include rollback plan.

alex_se: Drafting now — sample payload below to send to infra:

```
{
  "customer_id": "FIN-789",
  "change_type": "temporary_rate_limit",
  "rate_limit": {
    "requests_per_minute": 12000,
    "burst": 500
  },
  "allowlist_regions": ["ap-southeast-1"],
  "effective_window": {
    "start": "2025-03-26T17:00:00Z",
    "duration_days": 7
  }
}
```

raj_support: Nice. I'll create ticket S-3421 and add rollback step to remove ap-southeast-1 and reset rates back to baseline on +7 days.

infra-bot: Change request S-3421 created and validated. Change will be scheduled for 2025-03-26T17:00:00Z. Estimated rollout time: 10m.

alex_se: Also adding an observability watchlist: latency alert at p95 > 400ms and error-rate > 0.5% during window. Tia, can you coordinate enablement to collect feedback forms after training?

tia_success: Yep — I'll send the feedback form and a short survey link in the training channel. Will flag any complaints immediately.

maria_cs: Thanks team. Action items: (1) raj create ticket + rollback (S-3421) (2) infra apply change at window (infra-bot) (3) alex add alerts + monitor (4) tia collect feedback. I’ll update the CSM dashboard and note renewal risk mitigations. :thumbsup:

raj_support: On it — updating ticket with rollback playbook and perf checklist.

infra-bot: Change S-3421 queued. Post-change validation checks will run for 30m. Will notify here when complete.
